The zero set follows without possible cross-pole cancellations in the real part; the exact box count follows from distinct nonzero coordinate choices. value.rationale: The A3 root cuboctahedron is a canonical symmetric lattice polytope and the first 3-dimensional root polytope with triangular faces, contrasting with lattice zonotope multi-tiles. The pointwise periodization identity detects its precise failure to multi-tile at a constant multiplicity; the full integer Fourier support follows with all exact amplitudes and the closed count 24N^2+2N+1 for every box. This is a natural spectral/tiling invariant not a renaming, small gain or arbitrarily chosen frequency slice. The result can support analysis of lattice periodization and Fourier conditions for translational multiple tilings.
